\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{trees}

\tikzset{
  stage/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=18mm,minimum height=7mm,inner sep=2pt},
  every edge from parent/.style={draw,thick}
}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[grow=down,level distance=14mm,sibling distance=26mm]
  \node[stage,fill=blue!10] {Build}
    child[draw=\tone] foreach \stage/\tone in
      {Lint/green!50!black,Test/blue,Package/orange!80!black}
      {node[stage,draw=\tone] {\stage}};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
